verdict.rationale: CSC documents that it serves as a registered agent in all 50 states, DC, and international jurisdictions, so the core appointment capability exists. Nothing shows it can be bought online or that the agent name and street address are issued the same day; the only 'same-day' claim covers SOP document delivery, a different feature. Missing for 10: online self-serve purchase, same-day delivery of the exact agent name and street address for filings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can buy registered-agent service online and get the exact agent name and street address my formation or change filing needs the same day

citations.quote: CSC can serve as a registered agent in all 50 U.S. states, the District of Columbia, and key international jurisdictions.
CSC offers Registered Agent services across all 50 U.S. states, the District of Columbia, and major international jurisdictions.
